people.name: Tai Situ Rinpoche, Pema Wangcho Jalpo

relations.subject: Kalu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche began his formal studies at Palpung [dpal spungs] monastery at the age of thirteen.

relations.subject: Kalu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Here he completed the traditional three-year retreat under the direction of the retreat master, his Root Lama (tsa way la ma [rtsa ba'i bla ma]) the Venerable Lama Norbu Tondrup

relations.subject: Kalu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Kalu Rinpoche returned to Palpung and assumed duties as director (drup pön [sgrub dpon]) of the three-year retreats.

relations.subject: Lama Norlha
relations.evidence: while Lama Norlha's teachings on the Five Skandhas were translated by Dr. Janet Gyatso.
